instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures an outdoor scene next to a light-brown tiled wall in bright daylight. On the left, the man with dreadlocks in a yellow jersey (R2) stands facing the wall, leaning forward with both hands pressed flat against it. Behind him on the right, the bald security guard in a dark uniform (R1) leans forward, placing his right hand firmly on the shoulder of the man (R2). The guard's gaze is directed downward toward the man's back. The scene is illuminated by warm, natural daylight, casting soft shadows against the wall.
elements: R1 places his right hand firmly on R2's shoulder while R2 faces the wall
R2 presses both hands flat against the wall while R1 stands behind him
R1 looks downward toward R2's back rather than R2 monitoring R1
R2 leans forward facing the wall with R1 leaning forward behind him
light-brown tiled wall used as the surface R2 presses against
